assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds validation to check user-defined roles and policies for referential integrity.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: evidence does not specify which RBAC resources or policy components are affected by the referential integrity check; applicability: evidence does not specify what environment conditions trigger this validation or which configurations are affected; consequence: evidence does not specify what happens when referential integrity violations are detected (rejected, warning, error, etc.)
